fz0_n.description: Nominal vertical load the coefficients were fitted at, N.

id.description: Unique id; must equal the file stem (`data/tires/<id>.json`).

load_sensitivity.description: Load sensitivity `ls`: effective `D = d · (1 − ls · (Fz/Fz0 − 1))`, dimensionless.

peak_slip_angle_rad.description: Slip angle at peak lateral force, rad (informational / for assists).

peak_slip_ratio.description: Slip ratio at peak longitudinal force, dimensionless (for ABS/TCS targets).

relaxation_length_m.description: Relaxation length for the first-order slip lag, m.

rolling_resistance.description: Rolling resistance coefficient (force = coeff · Fz), dimensionless.

surface_multipliers.description: Grip multiplier per surface. Missing surfaces default to 1.0.

treaded.description:
Treaded tire (v0.3.0, weather W-4). `None` = treaded; slicks set `false` and
aquaplane much earlier.

wear_rate.description: Tread wear per metre of sliding distance at nominal load, fraction of tread (0..1) per m.

MagicFormula.description:
Simplified Pacejka Magic Formula coefficients for one axis:
`F = D · sin(C · atan(B·x − E·(B·x − atan(B·x))))`, with `D` a friction coefficient
(force = `D · Fz` before load sensitivity).

b.description: Stiffness factor B, dimensionless (per rad for lateral, per unit slip ratio for longitudinal).

d.description: Peak factor D as a friction coefficient at `fz0_n`, dimensionless.
